model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    park_name ILIKE '%nature reserve%'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name = 'Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region' AND border_type = 'planning_region'))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, true, (SELECT ST_Union(geometry::geometry) FROM nature_reserves)) AS rast_clipped
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT ST_Union(geometry::geometry) FROM nature_reserves))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(rast_clipped, 1, '32BF') AS rast_slope
  FROM 
    clipped_dem
),
area_and_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Area((SELECT ST_Union(geometry::geometry) FROM nature_reserves)::geography) AS total_area,
    ST_Stats(ST_Union(rast_slope), 1, true).mean AS mean_slope
  FROM 
    slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  total_area,
  mean_slope
FROM 
  area_and_slope;
```
